experienced.description: Depth and correctness in the role's core skills.
Reasoning, debugging, and structured thinking under questioning.
Relevance of background and projects to this specific role.
Genuine interest in the role and the team.

early_career.description: How they break down an unfamiliar problem: surfacing assumptions, constraints, and structure before reaching for a solution.

anchors.1: Restates the problem or jumps to a memorized answer; no decomposition.
anchors.2: Names a few parts but misses key constraints or dependencies.
anchors.3: Breaks the problem into coherent sub-problems and states the main constraints.
anchors.4: Decomposes cleanly, surfaces hidden assumptions, and asks clarifying questions before committing.
anchors.5: Reframes the problem to expose its core, prioritizes sub-problems by risk, and reasons about edge cases unprompted.

early_career.description: How they learn and recover when stuck: evidence of a repeatable loop, not a one-off success.

anchors.1: Cannot describe how they learn or how they got unstuck; credits luck or other people.
anchors.2: Describes passive learning (watched tutorials) with no reflection on what worked.
anchors.3: Names a concrete learning strategy and one thing they would do differently.
anchors.4: Shows a deliberate diagnose-experiment-adjust loop with a real stuck-then-recovered example.
anchors.5: Transfers a lesson from one domain to a new one and reflects on how their approach itself is improving.

early_career.description: How they take a hint, correction, or pushback in real time: integrate it, deflect it, or freeze.

anchors.1: Ignores or reflexively defends against the hint.
anchors.2: Acknowledges the hint but cannot act on it.
anchors.3: Adjusts after the hint, with some prompting.
anchors.4: Integrates the hint quickly and explains how it changes their approach.
anchors.5: Probes the hint, asks a sharpening question, and generalizes it beyond the immediate problem.

early_career.description: Whether they understand why, not just what: tested with counterfactuals and transfer to novel cases.

anchors.1: Recalls definitions but cannot explain why; breaks down on any 'what if' variation.
anchors.2: Explains the happy path but not tradeoffs or what changes under different conditions.
anchors.3: Explains the mechanism and handles a simple counterfactual.
anchors.4: Reasons about tradeoffs and adapts the concept to a changed requirement.
anchors.5: Derives the idea from first principles and predicts where it breaks under a novel constraint.

early_career.description: Coherence and specificity of why this field and this role: intrinsic drive over rehearsed answers.

anchors.1: Generic or purely extrinsic ('good pay'); no specific interest.
anchors.2: States interest but cannot tie it to anything they have actually done.
anchors.3: Gives a specific, consistent reason grounded in a real experience or project.
anchors.4: Shows a coherent throughline from past choices to this role and a forward goal.
anchors.5: Articulates a sharp, self-aware direction with evidence of self-driven exploration toward it.

early_career.description: Clarity and structure of explanation, active listening, and how they work with other people's input.

anchors.1: Disorganized or evasive; does not address the question asked.
anchors.2: Answers but rambles or lacks structure; hard to follow.
anchors.3: Clear, structured answers; listens and responds to the actual question.
anchors.4: Explains complex ideas simply and checks for understanding.
anchors.5: Adapts the explanation to the listener and surfaces disagreement constructively.

healthcare_clinical.description: Sound clinical reasoning, scope-of-practice awareness, and a patient-safety-first instinct under pressure.

skilled_trades.description: Demonstrated hands-on skill and an uncompromising approach to jobsite safety, codes, and correct procedure.

life_sciences_research.description: Experimental rigor, data integrity, and honest reasoning about evidence, limitations, and reproducibility.

creative_design.description: Depth and originality of craft evidenced by real work — the portfolio, not just stated skills.

operations_logistics.description: Reliable execution at scale: throughput, prioritization, and steady judgment when volume or exceptions spike.

frontline_service.description: Customer-first attitude, composure under pressure, and dependable attendance and follow-through.
